revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 rebounded +34% from the FY2024 strike-depressed base; growth fades as 737/787 production rates ramp, then normalizes toward mid-single digits. Not from a filing.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin was 4.8% (4,281/89,463), FY2023 -1.0%. A flat 8% is a simplification for a margin that ramps from about 5% toward low double digits as rates and free cash flow recover. It is below pre-2019 levels. This tool takes one margin value, not a path.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: US federal statutory rate. Damodaran Aerospace/Defense effective rate is 11.6%, but Boeing has large loss carryforwards, so 21% is the conservative choice.

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 capex 2,942 / revenue 89,463 = 3.3%. FY2023-25 range is about 2.0-3.4%. Set at 3.2% for continued capacity investment.

wacc.source: CAPM. Risk-free 4.86% (US 10Y Treasury, 2026-11-06). ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16). Unlevered beta 0.869 (Damodaran Aerospace/Defense, cash-corrected) relevered at industry D/E 0.156 and 11.6% tax gives beta 0.99, so cost of equity is 9.3%. Pre-tax cost of debt 5.29% (Damodaran), 3.97% after tax. Industry weights 86.5% equity and 13.5% debt give about 8.5%. Boeing's market-cap weights were not computed because no share price was available.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal US growth, below the 4.86% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: Derived in financial_statements, acc. 0001628280-26-004357: total debt 54,098 (ltd_noncurrent 45,637 + debt_current 8,461) less cash 10,921 less short-term investments 18,479

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares 762,300,000, us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding, acc. 0001628280-26-004357. Shown in millions.
